vision.name: Bardock's Wish
vision.text:
ENDURANCE 1.
(If this card is destroyed from your Life Deck by one of your effects, Rejuvenate it.)
POWER: Name a card. Your opponent cannot play that card this combat. Choose a non-[Continuous] Power of one of your MP levels. Use that Power.
(Banish after use.)
vision.note: Organized Play card (OP6 folder); grey card; possessive title -> Named; the infinity symbol in 'non-∞' is the Continuous icon
